file_note: Greenfield sign-off gates v2, written 2026-10-04 by Lee's FINAL-CHECK (Opus) from v1 and two refuter reviews. One goal per gate (GF-M1..M8 for the checker and machines, GF-G01..G28 for Greenfield); a gate's extra checks are part goals (GF-<gate>-P<n>) in its depends_on, so the gate is green only when every part is green. Runs on the outside checker as ${SCOREBOARD}/goals-greenfield.json with goals-greenfield.lock.
